name: Yuusha
source:
Hero Level 65535

A brave hero named Hagure has been traveling alone, unable to make friends.

He has devoted his entire life to overthrowing the Demon King.
However, as a result, he ends up falling behind the other heroes.
Having lost his mission, he decides to embark on a journey to do whatever he wants.

[Translated from [url=http://www.caramel-box.com/products/geko-brave/character.html]the game's Official Homepage[/url].]
